title: Micropack attestation triggers and pricing experiment for high-touch contracts
creator: Priya Patel
description: Goal: prototype a lightweight attestation 'micropack' flow and a tied pricing trigger so high-touch enterprise deals can receive fast, auditable security responses without incurring the full manual attestation costs. This ticket scopes the experiment, acceptance criteria, orchestration requirements, and measurement plan. Background: Sales and Solutions Engineering teams report causal delays when assembling CAIQ/SIG bundles for mid-sized customers. Current full-attestation process is labor-intensive. We want a lower-friction offering: a curated set of pre-approved answers + minimal supplemental evidence, cryptographically signed by Redwood, delivered as a compact artifact and optionally consumed by customer SSO/KMS reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Define micropack deliverable: questions subset, evidence checklist, and artifact format (JWS-signed bundle)
Implement backend API endpoint to generate micropack artifacts from templated answers and evidence pointers
Add UI workflow in Console: "Request Micropack" button for eligible accounts and attach to contract record
Pricing trigger: charge 'attestation credit' unit when micropack requested; first 3 micropacks free during pilot
Instrument metrics and dashboards (time-to-delivery, ops hours saved, customer satisfaction)
success_metrics: Reduce average turnaround time for security questionnaire responses from 3 business days to <8 hours for micropack-eligible requests
Decrease manual engineering hours per request by 60% during pilot
Pilot conversion: 25% of eligible accounts opt into micropack vs full attestation
No critical findings in micropack artifacts in initial 50 audits
rollout_plan: Week 0: finalize question subset with Security + Sales Ops (20 canonical answers)
Week 1: build templating engine and JWS signing integration with KMS; ENG epic kicked off (ENG-48921)
Week 2: Console UI mockups and review with Design; create feature flag gate
Week 3: internal beta with Solutions Engineering and 3 pilot customers; collect feedback
Week 4: measure metrics, iterate, and decide on broader pricing packaging or retire
risks_mitigation: Risk: Micropack answers may not satisfy large regulated customers. Mitigation: clearly label micropack scope and include upgrade path to full attestation.
Risk: Signed artifacts become stale after product changes. Mitigation: include artifact TTL and a reconciliation job; link to live evidence URLs.
Risk: Legal/Compliance pushback on charging model. Mitigation: Legal review in parallel and pilot pricing credit for first customers.
